_readme: Registered reconciling items between the data feeds and the general ledger. Each item explains a specific difference in one line and month; any difference not explained here (beyond the tolerance) fails the tie-out. Items are reviewed and cleared every cycle; an item that no longer matches a difference also fails, so stale entries cannot hide new breaks.

items.explanation: Provider settlement booked by manual journal entry; not in the claims feed. Excluded from experience studies; included in financial reporting.
